bomb-bmp.why: A header promising 100,000 by 100,000 pixels in a few hundred bytes: past the pixel cap, refused before a byte of the picture is decoded.

bomb-gif.why: A header promising 65,535 by 65,535 pixels in a few hundred bytes: past the pixel cap, refused before a byte of the picture is decoded.

bomb-ico.why: An icon whose one image is a PNG promising 100,000 by 100,000 pixels: refused as that PNG is.

bomb-jp2.why: A codestream whose SIZ promises 100,000 by 100,000 pixels: past the samples the JPEG 2000 decoder takes, refused before a sample is allocated.

bomb-jpeg.why: A header promising 65,535 by 65,535 pixels in a few hundred bytes: past the pixel cap, refused before a byte of the picture is decoded.

bomb-png.why: A header promising 100,000 by 100,000 pixels in a few hundred bytes: past the pixel cap, refused before a byte of the picture is decoded.

bomb-svg.why: An SVG 100,000,000 pixels a side: a vector drawing allocates nothing by its size; its page is cut to 14,400 points a side, the PDF limit, with a warning.

bomb-tiff.why: A header promising 100,000 by 100,000 pixels in a few hundred bytes: past the pixel cap, refused before a byte of the picture is decoded.

bomb-webp.why: A header promising 16,384 by 16,384 pixels in a few hundred bytes: past the pixel cap, refused before a byte of the picture is decoded.

deflate-bomb-png.why: A 100 by 100 PNG whose IDAT inflates to 64 MiB: the decoder stops past the rows the header gives and refuses the extra data.

deflate-bomb-tiff-strip.why: A 100 by 100 TIFF whose one Deflate strip claims 2^31 - 1 rows and inflates to 64 MiB: the strip is read as the page's 100 rows, so no more than the page's bytes are inflated.

ico-outside.why: An icon whose one image's offset lies past the file: no image lies inside it, nothing to print.

not-an-image.why: Text named as a PNG: the format is read from the bytes, never from the name.

tiff-loop.why: A TIFF of two pages whose last IFD links back to the first: the walk stops at the IFD it meets again, two pages.

truncated-bmp.why: The file cut in half: its picture's data ends early, so it does not read as its format.

truncated-gif.why: The file cut in half: its picture's data ends early, so it does not read as its format.

truncated-ico.why: The file cut in half: its picture's data ends early, so it does not read as its format.

truncated-jp2.why: A JP2 file cut in half: its codestream box declares more bytes than remain.

truncated-jpeg.why: A progressive JPEG cut in half: its frame header reads, and a JPEG is written as it is, never decoded, so a viewer draws the scans that remain.

truncated-png.why: The file cut in half: its picture's data ends early, so it does not read as its format.

truncated-tiff.why: The file cut in half: its picture's data ends early, so it does not read as its format.

truncated-webp.why: The file cut in half: its picture's data ends early, so it does not read as its format.

unsupported-avif.why: The signature of AVIF, which litho does not convert: refused as malformed, the message naming the format.

unsupported-heif.why: The signature of HEIF, which litho does not convert: refused as malformed, the message naming the format.

unsupported-jxl.why: The signature of JPEG XL, which litho does not convert: refused as malformed, the message naming the format.
